text:
devon: quick async — planning to enable feature flag "autoscale.burst_queueing" for canary audience 'canary-a' (10% traffic) tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Goal: observe latency/cost changes and any queue saturation. Proposed guardrails: max_concurrency=200, queue_timeout=60s, burst_tokens=2000, fallback_policy=queue_only. Tagging @priya for autoscaler check and @alex for SRE concerns.

priya: looks mostly ok. Quick Q: do we have per-model soft_cap enforcement? autoscaler respects soft_cap but we need override to prevent scale-to-zero during canary. Recommend adding min_replicas=2 for canary.

alex: SRE: queue_timeout 60s is safer. 120s will make client timeouts messy. Also add circuit-breaker: if queue length > 500 for >2min -> roll back flag. Add alert: queue_len > 300 for 5m.

sara: observability: add these metrics to dashboard: burst_tokens_used, burst_drops, queue_latency_p95. Can we tag canary traffic with canary_id so traces filter easily?

tamika: small ask on cost — burst_tokens=2000 might still spike cost. Suggest start at 1000 for first 2 hours then 2000. Also suggest ramping: 10% -> 30% after 6h if no issues.

devon: noted. Proposed rollout steps updated:

```
flag: autoscale.burst_queueing
audience: canary-a (10%)
ramp: 10% -> 30% after 6h if pass
guardrails:
  max_concurrency: 200
  min_replicas: 2
  queue_timeout_s: 60
  burst_tokens: 1000
  circuit_break_queue_len: 500
alerts:
  - queue_len>300 for 5m
  - error_rate>1% for 10m
fallback: queue_only -> serve-slow variant
```

devon: @priya can you confirm autoscaler will honor min_replicas and circuit-breaker? @alex please rubber-stamp SRE alerts. I can flip flag after confirmations during maintenance window (tomorrow 03:00 UTC). :eyes: 

priya: confirmed — autoscaler supports min_replicas and we can wire circuit-breaker via the existing monitor pipeline. I'll add a canary policy and link it.

alex: +1 on alerts. I'll add an SRE runbook entry and a short playbook for rollback. :thumbsup: 

sara: I added a draft dashboard and shared in #dashboards. Will populate canary_id filters.

tamika: ack. cost team ok with gradual ramp. :shipit: to proceed after confirmations.

devon: thanks all — I'll update the flag config and post the rollout plan here before flip. I'll also schedule a 15m watch at 03:15 UTC. If anything goes wrong, rollback to OFF for canary. :lock: 

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance window booked: 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC -> 03:30 UTC. Reminder sent to infra-oncall.

devon: awesome, closing loop.
